body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 041c526b90640609ea227611f087855c6372af5a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Refusal is complete. The post never writes U/V, G74/G75, G51/G52 or A words anywhere. The app emits `WireU`/`WireV` only ahead of a posed (tapered) move (`crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs:331`). Every place the post can see them is now refused: on a cut (`cutOk`, existing), on or before the first rapid (new `onRapid`, `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps:288-295`, which sets `sectionOk = false` so `startCut` writes no `G40 G00`/`T91`/`C`/`G01`), a `WireFourAxis` section (`onSection`), a `WireTaper` section and `WireAngle`. The lean flag resets at section end, so the next vertical section posts whole (pinned).
- Existing goldens untouched: the PR changes no golden, and `nc/sodick-wire/wire_slug_punch.nc` still passes byte-for-byte in the app suites.
- Pins are real: on main's `sodick-wire.cps`, `sodick_refuses_a_lean_before_the_first_rapid_and_threads_nothing` and `sodick_lean_refusal_resets_for_the_next_vertical_section` FAIL; the three refusal/unchanged tests pass on both.
- The decision doc records what the public Sodick manual states, what it leaves open, and why the 4-axis refusal stays (no worktable height in the machine file or stream), consistent with the issue's "Done means". Clean-room OK (manual only).

**Results (merged with main `upstream/main`, locally; no runner/Actions used)**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: post suites 146 tests passed, 0 failed (incl. `script_sodick_wire`, `sodick_taper`, `sodick_comp`, `sodick_four_axis`); app suites 75 tests passed, 0 failed (incl. `conformance`, `sodick_wire_post`, `sodick_alc400g`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Pins red on main: 2 of 5 fail as stated above.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Any `WireU`/`WireV` param, even a value of 0, refuses the section (same as the existing cut-time rule). The app only emits them for posed moves, so a vertical stream is unaffected.
- A refused section still writes its header comments and work-offset line (`G54`), but nothing that threads or cuts.
- #1499 also edits `sodick-wire.cps`; the hunks are separate, expect a trivial textual merge at most.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
